tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// yul lha a mye mdzangs ra can la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i dpag bsam zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dpag yas thugs rje'i pha rol kun gsal gyi// mtha' dang mnyam sang bla ma spyan ras gzigs// yan lag mchog gis btud pa'i phyag bgyis nas// a mye mdzangs ra'i bsang mchod gyer bsgom 'dri// 'di'i bsang mchod bya bar 'dod pas/ phye mar gtor ma lha shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa btang ba sogs spyi ltar byas la/ bsang mchod gzhan dang ma 'brel tshe/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs sogs lan gsum gyis skyabs 'gro sems bskyed bya/ bsang rdzas byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ bsang rdzas mi dmigs stong pa'i ngang nyid las// bsang mchod yo byad 'dod yon bsam mi khyab// bsang mchod mgron rigs kun gyi spyan lam du// bsang mchod 'dzad med rtag tu 'byung gyur cig /spyan 'dren pa ni/ kye bskal bzang rnam 'dren bzhi pa'i zhal lung gis// lung rtogs bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dar ba'i ljongs// bod yul che zhes bsngags pa'i nor 'dzin mthil// gnyan 'dong dang 'brel lhun chags ri bo'i logs// rdo rje'i brag ri brtsegs pa'i nang rol du// las bzang byed pos sprul pa'i khang bzang nas// mthu chen rab thob a mye mdzangs ra can// 'khor bcas spyan 'dren 'dir byon gdan la bzhugs// mgron gsal gdab pa ni/ rdzu 'phrul thogs med grub pa rnams kyi gzugs// rig pa'i rnam 'gyur grangs mthun ston pa'i phyir// mtha' gcig gzung du med kyang thun mong ngor// grags pa'i ming don mthun pa 'di lta ste// yul phyogs dge legs 'gugs shing bde 'byor dpal// bskyed pa gang tshe 'bol gdan gcan gzan gyi// pags pas bkab par lha chen mdzangs ra ni// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor zla rgyas dkar dmar mdangs// khro 'dzum nyams ldan ral pa'i zar bu dpyangs// reg 'jam gos bzang steng na dbang sngon gyi// khu bas btsos snyam dar gyi phod kas bklubs// mig sman ltar gnag rig sngags 'chang gi zhwa// rtse mor thod skam rdo rje 'bar bas mtshan// 'od 'bar dngul gyi me long tshon sna lnga'i// dar gyi cod paṇa mdzes pa dbu la gsol// phyag g.yas srid zhi'i bsod nams dpal 'byor dang*// rigs rgyud tshe g.yang 'gugs pa'i mda' dar bsnams// g.yon pas ci 'dod dngos grub dpal 'jo ba'i// rin chen gter gyi bum pa bzang po thogs// rdo rje'i ska rags bcings pa'i rked pa la// gnam lcags las grub rno dbal phur bus mtshan// sag ti dmar po'i l+h+wam gyis sgeg pa'i zhabs// g.yon brkyang rol pa'i stabs su 'gying bag bzhugs// yul khams dgra 'dre'i gnod pa dar ba dang*// nad yams grang sad gnam dmag bdo ba'i tshe// bsrung bzlog ting 'dzin zab mo'i sngags bzlas kyi// thun zor dmar gyi gtor mas tshar gcod byed// res 'ga' gnam lcags phur bu mkhar gdengs pas// gnod byed gzugs can gzugs med gang yin gyi// snying gar bsdigs pa'i 'jigs skrag ma bzod par// sde dang dpung bcas yul gzhan spyugs snyam byed// nang mchod 'bul ba dngos ni/

kye ngag gi mtshon rnon grub pa'i mdzangs ra rje// rang rigs sras dang btsun mo 'khor du bcas// thams cad dgyes pa'i bsang rdzas 'bul ba ni// nyer spyod 'dod pa'i yon tan gtor ma dang*// dkar mngar shing thog lo legs 'bru yi rigs// ja chang 'o phud phye mar mda' dar dang*// g.yag lug ra skyes ri dwags 'dab chags khyu// rigs mthun rtse 'jor rol pa 'di dag 'bul// lha shing bzang dgu sman spos bsregs pa'i sprin// nam mkhar khyab pa ci 'dod dpal 'jo zhing*// nyes skyon sbyang ba'i bsang mchod rgya chen 'di// mdzangs ra 'khor bcas mchod do dgyes par rol// phrin las bcol ba ni/ sngon tshe pad+ma 'byung gnas thang stong rgyal// mkhas grub skyes chen rim par byon rnams kyi// bka' lung 'phrin yig snying la bris don ltar// sems can phan pa'i byang chub sems mchog zung*// brtse chen snying po kun dga' bzang bcas pa'i// lugs bzang dri med chos spyod rnam pa bcu'i// bya bas bskyang ba'i bstan 'dzin ngur smrig 'chang*// grangs med 'dus pas dbyig 'dzin khyab par mdzod// bdag cag sbyin pa'i bdag po mi phyugs bcas// 'dre gdon 'byung po 'khrugs pa'i kha'i na bun// nad dang gdon bgegs gnod pa dus min 'chi// lo nyes rgud pa byung dang 'byung dogs tshe// khyed cag mthu stobs nus pa'i rtsal phyung nas// shugs drag dri bzhon 'tshubs mas bar snang gi /sprin sngon lang ling 'khrigs pa skad cig nyid// gar song cha med gtor bzhin zhi bar mdzod// tshe srog dpag bsam ring po'i rtsa bar brling*// bsod nams yal ga lo 'dab phyogs su rgyas// chos dang srid pa'i dngos 'byor 'dod dgu'i dpal// 'dzad med rtag tu 'byung ba'i stong grogs mdzod// rgyal ba'i sbyin stobs yul bdag mchod pa'i mthu// rgyu 'bras bslu med bden pas phyogs bcu nas// sde bzhi'i dpal 'byor phywa g.yang tshur bsdus la// sbyin bdag bde legs dpal dgu 'phel gyur cig

/bsang gzhung gzhan dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe// gshegs su gsol ba ni/ de ltar mchod pa'i tshul 'dis mgron rigs rnams// dgyes shing tshim nas gang dag bcol ba'i las// bsgrub par dam bca'i ri mo snying ga ru// gsal bar bkod de rang gnas gshegs shig kye// nyin mor bde legs mtshan bde legs// nyi ma'i gung yang bde legs shing*// nyin mtshan rtag tu bde legs pa// dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis shog /ces bkra shis kyis mtha' brgyan no// zhes yul lha a mye mdzangs ra can la bsang mchod 'bul ba'i yi ge 'dod 'jo'i dpag bsam zhes bya ba 'di ni/ ko bo a mye rin chen chos dar can gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyug ba gam gsum par sbyar ba dge legs phyogs las rnam par rgyal bar gyur cig /sarba maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
